<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Update a tracing account soft limit</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"put"} path={"/v1/account-management/consumption/tracing-accounts/{id}/soft-limit"}></MethodEndpoint>



Sets the soft limit of a **Consumption** tracing account.

The soft limit caps the daily volume, in GB, that the tracing account is allowed to index. It is the same value as the account's `maxDailyGB`: these endpoints read and write that value.

The account is suspended once its daily volume exceeds the soft limit, so `0` suspends it as soon as it receives any data. Setting a new soft limit releases the account if it is currently suspended.

The soft limits of all tracing accounts of the owner account together must not exceed the owner account's tracing budget, otherwise the request returns `400`.

`tracingAccountId` in the request body must match the `id` in the path, otherwise the request returns `400`.

Available for **Consumption** accounts only. If the account is not a Consumption account, the request returns `400`.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
